title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model, suggesting a successor to Google's EmbeddingGemma that extends text-only embeddings to handle multiple modalities. It targets efficient deployment for retrieval, semantic search, and RAG pipelines where compact, open embedding models are preferred over large proprietary alternatives.
